evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and adds `setprunelock` and `listprunelocks` in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp and src/rpc/client.cpp.
rationale: Adds missing RPC interfaces explicitly requested and tested by downstream tooling like electrs and external wallets to prevent blocks needed for rescanning from being pruned on pruned nodes. Reviewers confirmed that manual prune locks resolve a concrete integration gap for external software operating alongside pruned Bitcoin Core nodes.
